name: Official
description: The skins released with LaForge. Each draws light and dark.

skins.name: ant-colony
skins.label: Ant Colony
skins.description: A cross-section of the nest: soil strata, chambers for panes, the crew as ants and a glowing scent trail on whatever is busy.

skins.name: bridge
skins.label: Bridge
skins.description: A ship's bridge: cold steel bezels, cyan readouts, crew at their stations, red alert when someone needs you.

skins.name: dungeon-party
skins.label: Dungeon Party
skins.description: A candlelit tavern table: a parchment roster of adventurers, a quest log of spaces, and a d20 when only you can roll.

skins.name: heist-crew
skins.label: Heist Crew
skins.description: The job on a blueprint: white line work on a blue grid, every tab a step of the plan, red when someone's been made.

skins.name: kitchen-pass
skins.label: Kitchen Pass
skins.description: The line on a busy night: tabs are order tickets on a rail, panes are stainless stations under heat lamps, and blocked calls for Chef.

skins.name: mission-control-1969
skins.label: Mission Control 1969
skins.description: A flight control room: green phosphor screens in beige consoles, go/no-go lamps for every station, a teleprinter strip of the log.

skins.name: newsroom
skins.label: Newsroom
skins.description: Newsprint and ink: a masthead, serif headlines, column rules, and rubber stamps for the editor's desk and the press.
